comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This recipe (Making Female Nobel Dress) is available from Irene in the Marseille tavern. Sewing R10 required. Ingredients:

Satin x20
Gold Thread x20
Fine Fur x5

Stats:
Sociability +2
8k fame to equip; female-only and color-customizable

Cheers.
